faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: How is HOPAXI safer than app taxis?
faq.a1: HOPAXI uses coordinator-led dispatch, trained professional drivers, and pre-arrival pickup instructions to reduce uncertainty at arrival. You receive clear driver and meeting details before landing.
faq.a2: We use only the information needed to coordinate your transfer, support your trip, and issue receipts/facturas. We do not require unnecessary profile setup to confirm your booking.
faq.q3: How fast can I confirm a booking?
faq.a3: Most bookings are confirmed within 2 minutes once you share your flight number, arrival time, and destination via WhatsApp, SMS, or phone. We commit to ≤2-minute response during your active booking window.
faq.q4: What if my flight is delayed?
faq.a4: Your driver adjusts to your actual landing time at no extra charge. We track flight status in real-time and automatically re-time pickup to match your new arrival.
faq.q5: What is included in the fare?
faq.a5: Your quote includes vehicle, driver, airport tolls, parking, luggage assistance, and bilingual coordination. No hidden fees. The price you see is the price you pay.
faq.a6: Yes. Cancel up to 1 hour before scheduled pickup: full refund. Cancel within 1 hour: 50% service fee. After pickup begins: charged in full.
faq.q7: Do you provide official receipts or facturas?
faq.a7: Yes. Personal travelers get digital receipts. Corporate clients get official Peruvian factura (SUNAT-compliant) for business expense reporting.
faq.q8: How will I know my driver details before landing?
faq.a8: Before you land, you'll receive exact meeting point instructions (text + map) and driver details (name, vehicle plate, photo).
